en_title: Steven Spielberg Teams Up With Cillian Murphy for New Western Written by Paul Thomas Anderson
cn_title: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格携手基里安·墨菲拍摄新西部片，保罗·托马斯·安德森编剧
opus_summary: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格正在开发一部西部片，由基里安·墨菲和杰西·巴克利主演，保罗·托马斯·安德森编剧。影片改编自2024年小说《The Heart in Winter》，目前计划于2028年上映，并定于明年冬天开拍。斯皮尔伯格表示，这不会是他的最后一个项目。

paragraphs.en: Steven Spielberg is going big with his next film, which is a Western written by Paul Thomas Anderson and starring Cillian Murphy.
paragraphs.cn: 史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格的下一部电影将是一部大制作：这部西部片由保罗·托马斯·安德森编剧，基里安·墨菲主演。

paragraphs.en: Deadline confirmed that Spielberg is already developing his next film following the release of Disclosure Day this summer, and it'll be an adaptation of the 2024 novel The Heart in Winter. The book is set in 1891 amid a harsh winter in a Montana mining town. It follows a degenerate poet and ballad-maker who crosses paths with the new bride of the town's mine captain, sparking an intense love affair before they run west together with pursuers hot on their tail. Spielberg described the project to Deadline as a story about "people who refused to settle for a life that is less than they deserve but maybe more than they can handle."
paragraphs.cn: Deadline证实，斯皮尔伯格已经在筹备继今年夏天上映的《Disclosure Day》之后的下一部电影，该片将改编自2024年出版的小说《The Heart in Winter》。小说以1891年蒙大拿州一座矿业小镇的严冬为背景，讲述了一名堕落的诗人兼民谣创作者与镇上矿长的新婚妻子相遇，两人展开一段炽烈的恋情，随后一起向西逃去，追兵紧随其后。斯皮尔伯格向Deadline介绍该项目时称，这是一个关于「那些拒绝满足于低于自己应得的生活，却可能追求着超出自己承受能力的生活的人」的故事。

paragraphs.en: Cillian Murphy and Jessie Buckley will play the leading characters in the film, which is apparently still untitled despite being sourced from an existing piece of work. He has also teamed with Oscar-winner Paul Thomas Anderson, who is penning the script. This marks the first time Anderson has fully written a script that he himself hasn't directed, but he has done uncredited punch-ups and rewrites on other movies like Killers of the Flower Moon.
paragraphs.cn: 基里安·墨菲和杰西·巴克利将在片中饰演主角。尽管改编自现有作品，这部电影显然仍未定名。斯皮尔伯格还与奥斯卡得主保罗·托马斯·安德森合作，由后者撰写剧本。这是安德森首次完整撰写一个不由自己执导的剧本，不过他曾为《花月杀手》等其他电影进行未署名的润色和改写。

paragraphs.en: “It’s really the excitement for me to get to work together with my dear friend and colleague Paul Thomas Anderson on a genre, but more particularly, the genre notwithstanding, a story that quite quickly became close to both our hearts and we felt that we could do as a team," said Spielberg about the partnership.
paragraphs.cn: 谈及这次合作，斯皮尔伯格说：「能和我亲爱的朋友兼同行保罗·托马斯·安德森一起创作一部类型片，真的让我很兴奋。但更具体地说，撇开类型不谈，这是一个很快就让我们两人都深感亲切的故事，我们觉得可以携手把它拍出来。」

paragraphs.en: The two began flirting with the idea of working together back in January while Anderson was on the awards trail for One Battle After Another, which cleaned up at the various ceremonies and led to him receiving an Oscar for Best Adapted Screenplay . Naturally, that kind of prestige makes him a smart pick to adapt a layered novel such as this one. The two binged old Westerns on 35mm film as part of their creative process.
paragraphs.cn: 早在一月，两人就开始考虑合作，当时安德森正为《一场又一场的战斗》参与颁奖季活动。这部电影在各大颁奖典礼上斩获颇丰，也让他获得了奥斯卡最佳改编剧本奖。自然，这样的声望使他成为改编这类层次丰富的小说的明智人选。作为创作过程的一部分，两人集中观看了35毫米胶片放映的老西部片。

paragraphs.en: Spielberg's untitled Western is currently targeting a 2028 release, with filming set to begin next winter. The 79-year-old director was also quick to note that this is not his final project and denied that this was some kind of metaphor about his career, where he gets to literally ride off into the sunset at the end.
paragraphs.cn: 斯皮尔伯格这部尚未定名的西部片目前计划于2028年上映，定于明年冬天开拍。这位79岁的导演还立即指出，这并非他的最后一个项目，并否认这与他的职业生涯有某种隐喻关系，让他最终真的骑马消失在夕阳中。

paragraphs.en: “If I wanted to ride off into the sunset, I would have done Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade next, and I could have had those characters literally riding off into the sunset as the credits roll,” Spielberg said.
paragraphs.cn: 斯皮尔伯格说：「如果我想骑马消失在夕阳中，我下一部就会拍《夺宝奇兵3》，让那些角色在演职员表滚动时真的骑马消失在夕阳中。」
